rules.title: Acknowledge after processing
rules.text: Acknowledge a message only after it has been processed successfully.

rules.title: Idempotent consumers
rules.text: Make consumers idempotent because delivery is at least once.

rules.title: Dead-letter queues
rules.text: Configure a dead-letter queue with a bounded retry count and alert on messages that land there.

rules.title: Visibility timeout above processing time
rules.text: Set the visibility timeout (SQS) or acknowledgement timeout above the longest expected processing time.

rules.title: Small messages
rules.text: Keep messages small and store large payloads elsewhere, passing a reference.

rules.title: Bound prefetch
rules.text: Use manual acknowledgements with a bounded prefetch (often 100 to 300); unbounded prefetch lets unacknowledged messages pile up in consumer memory.
